item.title: 21 Aug — Guardrails are moving; so should our spreads
item.description:
21 Aug — What actually moved
- UK/Gibraltar — UKGC settles with QuinnBet (Gibraltar) Limited (£609,104) for AML and safer‑gambling failures (examples include 4,800 bets in a day not flagged; SoF gaps). Published 20 Aug. Why it matters: it’s the regulator we sit under for GBR access and a near‑neighbor to GLA‑167; messaging and controls are getting stricter on velocity, 18–24s, and source‑of‑fund…
